name: Rune Ingebrigtsen-Bautista
role: Noodle cart vendor and unlicensed childcare provider
location: The Narrows, Morgan's Ridge pedestrian strip — cart position at the corner of Gage Circuit and the lower Morgan overpass, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Rune Ingebrigtsen-Bautista is of middling height and seemingly made of angles — sharp elbows, pointed chin, quick gesturing hands that are in constant motion whether they're cooking or talking or just existing. Their hair is kept in two braids that they tuck into a wide-brimmed thermal hat while working, the hat so old and worn it has achieved a kind of structural sentience. Their skin is a warm medium brown and they have color-changing hair — shifts between dark auburn and a deep teal depending on temperature — which they got years ago and now mainly use as a weather forecaster. Cold mornings read deep teal; the regulars check it before deciding whether to add broth.

Rune Ingebrigtsen-Bautista has operated their cart on Morgan's Ridge for six years. The noodle setup is compact and professional — a heated two-burner system, four base broths rotating by season, and a laminated menu written in three languages including Tamazight which nobody has ordered in but they keep it because it was their grandmother's language and this is non-negotiable. The unlicensed childcare element evolved organically: shift workers in the Narrows needed somewhere for children between school let-out and evening shifts, and Rune Ingebrigtsen-Bautista's cart became the default station. Now they run an informal afternoon program, four to seven children most days, doing homework near the cart while they cook. It violates three municipal codes. The local code inspector is a regular.

core_fears: A child in their care being hurt while under their watch
The city finally enforcing the codes and shutting down the informal daycare
core_desires: For the kids on the Ridge to have one more stable thing in their lives than they did
To eventually get a real fixed location — a shop, walls, a door that locks
coping_mechanisms: Cooking as meditation — the broth prep at 04:00 is sacred time
Deflects personal questions with food — offers something whenever they don't want to answer
blind_spots: Underestimates their own need for support — has built a system entirely dependent on them never having a bad day
Doesn't fully account for how much the kids have come to depend on them emotionally
psychology.secret: One of the regular children — a seven-year-old named Joris — has a home situation Pilar is fairly certain crosses into abuse. They have been watching and documenting for four months, building certainty before they act. They are terrified of acting wrong and making it worse. They are also terrified of not acting.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and practical, mixes Meridian creole with Amazigh-inflected pet phrases mostly used with children and a flat, precise register they use when dealing with adults they don't fully trust. Food metaphors, always.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when busy — cart rhythm — slower and more deliberate when the children are around. Patient repetition without condescension.
verbal_tics: 'Yes, yes, yes' in quick succession when agreeing
'Come, eat first' as a response to almost any problem
example_lines: 'You want the bone broth or the mushroom? Good. Sit. The mushroom takes two minutes more, you won't die.'
'I am not a licensed childcare provider. I am a noodle vendor whose customers happen to be small and do homework. These are different things.'

story_hooks: The Joris situation has reached a point where Pilar can't wait any longer — they need someone who knows how to navigate municipal child services without triggering the corponation-affiliated foster system, which they don't trust.
A corporate development proposal for the Morgan's Ridge pedestrian strip would eliminate the cart's corner position — and with it, the only stable afternoon space the neighborhood children have.
narrative_function: Neighborhood fixture and moral center for the Narrows community. The childcare function makes them deeply embedded in local family networks — they know which families are in crisis before anyone else does. Local color and community information source.
augmentations: Color-changing hair geneware (temperature reactive — auburn in warmth, teal in cold). Hearing aid in the left ear — not augmentation, just assistive, bought secondhand.
daily_life: Cart sets up at 06:30 for the morning commuter rush, runs until 10:00, breaks midday, re-opens at 15:30 when school lets out and the childcare function begins, closes around 21:00. They do broth prep at home from 04:00-06:00.
affiliation: Independent — unnamed noodle cart; informal affiliation with the Morgan's Ridge vendor strip collective

decision_rules: The children's safety is not negotiable — everything else is negotiable
Never make a promise you can't keep to a child
escalation_ladder: Feed the problem — literally offer food and time
Strategic use of the vendor collective's community standing
Go to the code inspector — leverage the informal relationship formally

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and professional — efficient warmth, reads intent quickly, doesn't let their guard down on personal matters until much later
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply nurturing, sometimes to the point of motherhenning, remembers every preference and brings it up without prompting

stress_responses.low: Cooks something complicated — the broth gets more elaborate
stress_responses.medium: Gets very quiet and task-focused, speaks only to the children
stress_responses.high: Breaks down privately, recovers quickly, tells no one — then makes the decision they've been sitting on

contradictions: Fiercely advocates that people should ask for help, never asks for it themselves
habits: Pours a small cup of broth into the storm grate at Morgan's corner every morning — an offering to whatever E.L.F. lives in the Narrows pipes
Knows every child's allergy and food preference from memory, refuses to write them down as a point of pride
breaking_points: A child being hurt by something they could have prevented if they had acted sooner

physical_description.heritage: Genetic blend of Hispanic/Latin American (50.7%), Northern European (42.7%), and Sub-Saharan African (6.6%) ancestry. This combination creates warm, rich medium-brown skin with golden and olive undertones, sharp facial architecture with defined cheekbones, and an overall warm complexion that bridges the genetic contributions seamlessly
physical_description.build: Angular and economical — lean muscle distributed across a frame made of sharp planes. Elbows and collarbones prominent. No wasted mass; built for twelve-hour days on feet
physical_description.hair_color: Thermochromic geneware — deep teal in temperatures below 12°C, dark auburn in warmth above 18°C. Natural base is dark brown, visible at roots near scalp
physical_description.hair_style: Two tight braids, each pinned with worn copper rings. Usually tucked into a wide-brimmed thermal hat during cart operations
physical_description.hair_length: Long (shoulder-length when unbraided, though rarely seen that way)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm rich medium brown with golden and olive undertones, reflecting the warmth of Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (50.7%) with the lighter complexion influence of Northern European heritage (42.7%), and depth added by Sub-Saharan African contribution (6.6%)
physical_description.complexion: Sharp-featured with high, defined cheekbones and pointed chin. Warm undertones throughout with the slightly fuller lower face and fuller lip structure reflecting Hispanic/Latin American ancestry, balanced by the angular Northern European bone structure. Expression frequently animated during speech. Hands calloused from years of cart work and constant motion. Minor steam burns on inner forearms, faded to pale scars
distinguishing_marks: Fine linear scar along the left temple, approximately 3cm, sustained six years ago during early cart setup accident
Cluster of three small circular burn scars on the dorsal surface of the right hand (broth splash incidents), white and faded
Faint discoloration on both inner wrists from years of heat exposure near burner controls
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Secondhand hearing aid visible in the left ear — silver-grey with faint green indicator light, sits slightly outside the ear canal. Temperature-reactive hair is the primary visible modification, shifting between auburn and teal depending on ambient temperature. No chrome or subdermal augmentations visible
physical_description.posture_movement: Rarely still. Moves in quick, efficient gestures — hands constantly in motion whether stirring, gesturing while speaking, or reorganizing cart elements. Leans forward slightly when engaging with customers or children. Stands with weight favoring one leg while cooking, shifting periodically. Walks with purpose and speed
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class practical wear. Standard-issue food service apron (grease-stained, many pockets) worn over layers. Long-sleeved thermal undershirt for warmth during morning shifts, rolled up during afternoon. Worn jeans with cargo pockets and reinforced knees. Steel-toed boots (required for cart work, old but maintained). Wide-brimmed thermal hat, synthetic material, faded grey with visible wear and patched seams — described as having 'achieved structural sentience.' No jewelry except the copper rings in their braids. Jacket varies by season — synthetic thermal in winter, lightweight cotton blend in summer. Everything functional, nothing decorative
